articles.title: Court Says Pentagon's Transgender Troop Ban Is Illegal
articles.summary: A court just ruled that the Pentagon can't ban transgender people from serving in the military just because of who they are. But the ban is still in place for now while more legal fights happen.

articles.title: EU Plans to Send Migrants to Detention Centers Outside Europe
articles.summary: The European Union just agreed on tough new rules to deport more people and build detention centers in other countries. Critics say it's like copying harsh U.S. immigration policies and could hurt human rights.

articles.title: Mystery Messages and Missing Papers: What the Mandelson Files Don't Tell Us
articles.summary: The UK government released 1,500 pages about Lord Mandelson's appointment as US ambassador. But key messages are missing, phones were stolen, and answers about his ties to Jeffrey Epstein are still secret.
